title: NigraNet: An automatic framework to assess nigral neuromelanin content in early Parkinson's disease using convolutional neural network
summary: The checked primary abstract reports this specific result: CNN framework (NigraNet) segments substantia nigra on NM-MRI in early PD with manual-reference validation, enabling a distinct neuromelanin quantification result in patients versus healthy volunteers. The abstract identifies the model or learned operation and an observed evaluation; the conclusion is limited to the reported study setting. Original PMC full-text Methods and Results were checked; date 2022-10-31 reconciled to the primary record. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
